mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_rooms(id, name, type, avatar_url, created_by) VALUES(#{id}, #{name}, #{type}, #{avatarUrl}, #{createdBy})
mapper.select: SELECT r.* FROM chat_rooms r WHERE r.type = 'DIRECT' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM chat_room_members m1 WHERE m1.room_id = r.id AND m1.user_id = #{userId1}) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM chat_room_members m2 WHERE m2.room_id = r.id AND m2.user_id = #{userId2}) LIMIT 1

SELECT r.id, r.name, r.type, r.avatar_url, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_room_members mm WHERE mm.room_id = r.id) AS member_count, lm.content AS last_message_content, lm.created_at AS last_message_at, COALESCE(NULLIF(lu.display_name, ''), lu.username) AS last_message_sender_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_messages msg WHERE msg.room_id = r.id AND msg.created_at > COALESCE(m.last_read_at, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01 00:00:00')) AS unread_count FROM chat_rooms r JOIN chat_room_members m ON m.room_id = r.id AND m.user_id = #{userId} LEFT JOIN chat_messages lm ON lm.id = (SELECT id FROM chat_messages WHERE room_id = r.id ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1) LEFT JOIN users lu ON lu.id = lm.sender_id WHERE r.type = 'GROUP' ORDER BY lm.created_at DESC
